calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for OHL
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne demoed the platform to Jorge Bañuelos, a consultant and de facto chief data officer at One Health Link (OHL), who needs a HIPAA-compliant A/B testing tool for ML and LLM experiments to replace error-prone homegrown methods. Key features discussed included self-hosting (initially to bypass slow compliance), enterprise options with CUPED, sequential testing, and multi-armed bandit, plus warehouse
